paper_metadata.title: A 225mW 28Gb/s SerDes in 40nm CMOS With 13dB of Analog Equalization for 100GBASE-LR4 and Optical Transport Lane 4.4 Applications Mike Harwood1, Steffen Nielsen2, Andre Szczepanek1, Richard Allred2, Sean Batty1, Mike Case2, Simon Forey1, Karthik Gopalakrishnan3, Larry Kan3, Bob Killips1, Parmanand Mishra2, Rohit Pande3, Hamid Rategh3, Alan Ren3, Jeff Sanders2, Albrecht Schoy3, Richard Ward3, Martin Wetterhorn2, Norman Yeung2

references.sentence: A block diagram of the complete SerDes is shown in Fig. 19.2.1.
The transmitter is shown in Fig. 19.2.2.
The receiver and equalizer are shown in Figs. 19.2.1 and 19.2.3.
Figure 19.2.4 shows a conventional PMOS based low-drop-out regulator with the use of both lowand high-frequency correction loops to enhance the PSRR.
A quad SerDes measures 2.4×1.5mm2 and is implemented in a TSMC 40G technology (Fig. 19.2.5).
Lab measurements at 28Gb/s are shown in Fig. 19.2.6.

Joy et al., “Analog DFE Based 16Gb/s SerDes in 40nm CMOS that operates across 34dB Loss channels at Nyquist with a baud rate CDR and 1.2V voltage mode driver,” ISSCC Dig Tech Papers, pp. 350-351, Feb. 2011.
